'''Thape''' was a celestial body<ref name="TEA" /> located in the [[Thape system/Legends|Thape system]], a part of the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked it to the [[Ando system/Legends|Ando]] and [[Leritor system/Legends|Leritor systems]]. Between around [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]], the 
society of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] known as the [[Order of Dai Bendu]]<ref name="TEA" />&mdash;which was present on<ref name="DotJ1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]]</ref> the Ando [[Star system/Legends|system]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Ando">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030703ando|text=Ando: Planet of the Walrus Men|int=Ando: Planet of the Walrus Men}}</ref> [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]] as early as approximately [[37,453 BBY]]<ref name="DotJ1" /> and as late as around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref name="32 BBY">The events of ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer]]'', which include the appearance of the [[Order of Dai Bendu]] on [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]], take place at some point by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of those of {{Film|I}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref>&mdash;had a presence at Thape.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thape was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-15.<ref name="TEA" /> It shares its name with "Usby C. J. Thape," a misspelling present in ''[[Skywalking: The Life and Films of George Lucas]]''&mdash;a [[1984]] biography of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' franchise's creator, [[George Lucas]], by [[Dale Pollock]]<ref name="Skywalking">''[[Skywalking: The Life and Films of George Lucas]]''</ref>&mdash;of the name of "[[Chuiee Two Thorpe|C. J. Thorpe]]," the "[[Padawan/Legends|padawaan learner]]" of the "[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi-bendu]]" [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windy]] mentioned in [[Journal of the Whills, Part I|''Journal of the Whills (Part) I'']], which was the earliest story outline that Lucas wrote in [[1973]] while developing the first part of the [[original trilogy]], the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="YearByYear">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref>
